description: Javno dostopne WiFi točke v Občini Mokronog-Trebelno is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA MOKRONOG - TREBELNO. The list contains publicly accessible WiFi points in the Municipality of Mokronog-Trebelno. Coverage: OBČINA MOKRONOG - TREBELNO. The portal shows the English title as "Publicly accessible WiFi points in the Municipality of Mokronog-Trebelno" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA MOKRONOG - TREBELNO. Its keywords include WiFi, brezžično omrežje, dostopne točke. The listing shows 3 download or service links in HTML, CSV, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
